problem: What are the parametric equations of the hyperbola $\frac{{y}^{2}}{25}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{16}=1?$
worked_solution:
The parametric equations of a vertical hyperbola centered at the origin with Cartesian equation

$$
\frac{{y}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1
$$

are given by

$$
x=b\operatorname{tan}⁡t,\,y=a\operatorname{sec}⁡t.
$$

In our case, $a=\sqrt{25}=5$ and $b=\sqrt{16}=4.$ Therefore, the parametric equations are

$$
x=4\operatorname{tan}⁡t,\,y=5\operatorname{sec}⁡t.
$$
